verses.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁਰਬ ਦੇਵ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਪੁਰਬ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੁਰ ਕੋਟਿਨ ਕੋਟਾਨਿ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: teerath purab dhev jaatraa jaat hai jagat purab teerath sur koTin koTaan kai ||

en.bdb: People of the world visit various places of pilgrimage on various days considered auspicious by them. But such days and holy places associated with gods are numerous.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਬਿਬਿਧ ਫਲ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਹੈ ਸਾਧ ਰਜ ਕੋਟਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: mukat baiku(n)Th jog jugat bibidh fal baa(n)chhat hai saadh raj koT giaan dhiaan kai ||

en.bdb: Millions of seekers of Salvation, heaven and many methods of performing Yoga, worldly knowledge and contemplations long for the holy dust of the feet of saintly True Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਸੰਖ ਸਿਖ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਚਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਰਾਮ ਰਸ ਆਨਿ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: agam agaadh saadh sa(n)gat asa(n)kh sikh sree guroo bachan milai raam ras aan kai ||

en.bdb: There are numerous devoted Sikhs of the True Guru in the holy assembly of the inaccessible and serene True Guru who receive the sermon of how to reach the blissful state of enjoying ambrosial name of the Lord through meditation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਲਿਵ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ਕੈ ॥੩੯੬॥
verses.translit_en: sahaj samaadh apara(n)par purakh liv pooran braham satigur saavadhaan kai ||396||

en.bdb: Such Sikhs of the Guru engross themselves in silent meditation of Lord's name that the imperceptible, inaccessible, perfect and God-like True Guru has blessed them with. Their engrossment is highly attentive and in a state of serenity. (396)
